headline.title: Pre-season: cold nights ahead.
headline.text: 17 of the 31 resorts close to opening get nights cold enough to make snow, mostly in White Mountains and Western Maine. Killington typically opens first, around Nov 8.

BTV.excerpt:
Warm and breezy conditions expected across the region today ahead of a weak cold front. Some light rain showers will be possible tonight into Friday, with drier conditions returning for the weekend.
Increased fire weather concerns through this weekend.
November will begin with dry, above normal temperatures, and remaining uncertain for the timing of precipitation in a week.

ALY.excerpt:
) A cold front will bring some light rain showers mainly from the Capital District and points north and west tonight followed by drier and breezy conditions on Friday.
) Dry weather is expected this weekend through early next week with the next best chance for more widespread rainfall delayed until mid to late next week.

GYX.excerpt: High pressure continues to dominate the weather into next week. Expect mainly dry conditions and no significant weather impacts.

BUF.excerpt:
)Record warmth possible today.
)A chance of showers tonight. Dry weather then resumes Friday and lasts through the weekend.

PHI.excerpt:
Spotty minor tidal flooding expected with this morning's high tide.
Areas of fog and low clouds anticipated this morning. Otherwise, no other significant weather impacts with generally tranquil conditions through early next week.

RLX.excerpt: ) Dry and slightly above seasonable weather dominates into the weekend. Rain chances returns to the forecast for the beginning of November.

writeups.name: Vermont
writeups.title: Dry, with cold nights.
paras: Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:27}} to {{t:55}}, with rain at times.
Killington usually opens first here, around Nov 8. Jay Peak gets the most hours cold enough to make snow this week (about 23).

NWS Burlington forecasters, Thursday 6:50 AM: "Warm and breezy conditions expected across the region today ahead of a weak cold front. Some light rain showers will be possible tonight into Friday, with drier conditions returning for the weekend."
writeups.outlook: Days 8 to 14: NOAA's outlook leans warmer than normal and slightly wetter than normal. Wet and mild often means rain below the summits.

Typically opens around Nov 27, 29 days out.
